cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Remember Me Correctly
cards.instruction: Create small tests of whether someone remembers your preferences, stories, or shared history.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've put quotation marks round our holiday caption like yours. What did I say when we missed that boat?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Mine were round the name of the ferry. I remember you laughing, not what you said.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes, names first. It started, 'That's the last time we trust...' Who did I mean?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can't we just call it 'Happy memories'?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Choose one for me to remember happily: your watch, my French, or the man selling watches?

reason: Replace decorative confidence prefixes with a particular misunderstood cue, its correction, and continued confident pursuit of the exact Drive; preserve responsive partner choices.
